_comment: Two-axis, explainable lead scoring. MOTIVATION (0-100) = call-order priority knowable from the filing + owner profile; always available, even on unenriched leads. EQUITY (0-100) = deal-margin PROXY measured from CAD enrichment (no lien balance exists anywhere, so equity is a proxy, never a computed dollar figure); null with a confidence flag when the join refuses. TIER (A/B/C/D + A_UNVERIFIED) comes from the motivation x equity matrix. Every weight here is editable; scripts never hardcode them.

motivation._comment: Distress TYPE folds in competition + thin-equity priors (decision: motivation is net call-order, not pure willingness). Family/partition tops the list; lender foreclosure is folded down for auction competition + thin equity. A HIGH-confidence family match PROMOTES the distress type to FAMILY (uses the 40 base); a MED match keeps the INDIVIDUAL base and adds familyMedNudge. Recency scales the distress base only. Institutional owners are floored regardless of what else fires.

ownerOccupancy._comment: Occupant homestead = relocation stress (strong). Absentee small-investor = tired landlord (weak). Institutional = neither (floored).

equity._comment: Weighted average of the scaled evidence that EXISTS (missing components are renormalized out, not scored as zero), then a plaintiff prior adjustment, clamped 0-100. Confidence: HIGH = cap-gap AND appreciation both computable; MED = one of them; LOW = tenure only; NONE = unenriched.

tiers._comment: A = motivated AND equity-confirmed. A_UNVERIFIED = motivated but unenriched (verify equity, don't bury). B = one axis high. C = both middling. D = weak/institutional.
